storage-cove-m0-keys.reason: Reads, migrates and removes the localStorage keys (workspace state and node scrollback) that builds before the rename wrote under the old key prefix, now opencove:m0:.

sqlite-workspace-state-kv.reason: Imports the pre-table workspace-state-raw KV row into the normalized SQLite schema when a version 1 database is opened, then drops the KV table.

canvas-space-collapse-legacy.reason: Converts Space disclosure ids saved before windows could collapse into collapsedNodeIds when a workspace opens.

settings-legacy-fields.reason: Normalizes settings written by older builds: per-provider model lists, the UI font scale percent, the pre-toggle pixel effect and canvas background flags, the optional sidebar view fields, and the full-access default of existing installs.

terminal-display-calibration-legacy-stor.reason: Reads the sidecar calibration metadata that builds before the atomic calibration record wrote, and reports it as legacy proof.

terminal-recovery-legacy-records.reason: Reads recovery records and checksums written before durable runtime bindings, and mirrors scrollback into node_scrollback rows for readers that predate recovery records.

home-worker-config-legacy-lease.reason: Recognizes the single-file home Worker configuration lease written by earlier builds next to the current lease directory.

legacy-managed-agent-hooks.reason: Removes OpenCove-managed hook entries that earlier builds wrote into the user's Claude settings, Codex hooks.json and Codex config.toml, leaving user-owned entries alone.

legacy-cli-launchers.reason: Repairs launcher scripts written by builds before the CLI shipped as one built file, so they point at the packaged CLI instead of src/app/cli/opencove.mjs.

managed-claude-worker-support.reason: Keeps Claude sessions on the legacy creation and resume path when the Worker or the client does not declare managedClaudeResumeBindingV1, and shows the upgrade notice.

managed-claude-bindings-kill-switch.reason: OPENCOVE_MANAGED_CLAUDE_BINDINGS=0 lets a Worker administrator pause managed Claude restarts and new resume targets.

legacy-worker-process-identity.reason: Identity checks for Worker processes whose metadata predates the kernel lease, so a new Worker does not take over a live older one.

pty-geometry-legacy-revision.reason: Falls back to numeric geometry revisions when the peer cannot acknowledge operation ids: Desktop and browser clients against older Workers, and Workers against older upstream endpoints.

endpoint-runtime-legacy-failure.reason: Recognizes the runtime_legacy bootstrap failure that older managed runtimes report and projects it as an endpoint health state.

remote-persistence-legacy-outcome.reason: Treats write results of remote persistence adapters that predate outcome reporting as legacy, and accepts the legacy "unknown" rejection reason.

control-surface-legacy-validation.reason: legacyNormalize and defineLegacyOperation reproduce the pre-schema validation errors and raw-key handling for CLI and API callers; the frozen oracles and parity specs prove the schemas agree.

cli-legacy-input-handling.reason: The CLI still accepts input of older peers: bare legacy ids in the selector (ids that are not UUIDs), probed for an exact target before a name or prefix is accepted, and turn-end events from a Worker that predates lastEndedTurn (#556), which the agent wait command accepts when the snapshot has no lastEndedTurn.

space-update-legacy-node-move.reason: Keeps the always-empty movedNodeIds field in Space update results for clients written when boundary updates still moved nodes.

ai-naming-temporary-flag.reason: Temporary switches that keep task title generation and worktree name suggestion off while the AI naming flows are refactored.

codex-legacy-notify-bridge.reason: Codex builds without lifecycle hooks (verified against Codex 0.166.0, which has them) only report turns through the notify bridge, so run-state arbitration keeps a legacy notify path next to hook evidence.

agent-legacy-run-state-label.reason: Agent run state keeps the single legacy `state` label next to the structured run state for existing UI and API consumers; it never feeds decisions.

pi-agent-settled-fallback.reason: Pi releases without the agent_settled event (verified against Pi 0.80.7, which emits it) need an idle check after agent_end, which the generated Pi status extension carries as its agent_end handler.

opencode-tui-legacy-theme.reason: Answers OpenCode color queries and theme-mode reports from terminal.options.theme and a legacy report key while no applied appearance exists; the bridge is verified against OpenCode 1.3.13.

github-pull-requests-legacy-resolve.reason: Resolves pull requests through the pre-mount integration.github.resolvePullRequests API for branches of Spaces that carry no mount id.

terminal-profile-legacy-runtime-kind.reason: Infers the runtime kind (WSL, Windows or POSIX) from the shell path for profiles saved without one; wsl.exe is the Windows WSL launcher that decides the WSL case.
